connector.name: Splark
connector.registryDescription: Async video interviews: send a link, get short video answers with transcripts and AI captions.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.splark.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.splark, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key>. Mint an API key (sk_live_…) in the Splark dashboard, or POST https://api.splark.com/api/signup with {"email":"you@company.com"} to create a free account (20 shorts/month) and receive a key. OAuth-capable clients (claude.ai web, Claude Desktop connectors) can skip the header and use the Connect flow instead — the endpoint answers 401 with OAuth resource metadata.
